Platform Utils Exported Macros

group PLATFORM_UTILS_Exported_Macros

Defines

ABS(x) (((x) > 0) ? (x) : ((~(x)) + 1))

Computes the absolute value of x.

BIT64(_n) (1ULL << (_n))

Computes the bitwise representation of 1 shifted left by _n places, for 64-bit integers.

DIVIDE_AND_ROUND(dividend, divisor) (((dividend) + ((divisor) >> 1)) / (divisor))

Divides dividend by divisor and rounds the result to the nearest integer.

DIVIDE_AND_ROUNDUP(dividend, divisor) (((dividend) + ((divisor) - 1)) / (divisor))

Divides dividend by divisor and rounds the result up to the nearest integer.

CLOCK_COUNT_DIFF(clk_begin, clk_end, bit_mask)

(((((uint64_t) clk_end & ((uint64_t) bit_mask - 1)) | (uint64_t) bit_mask) - \

((uint64_t) clk_begin & ((uint64_t) bit_mask - 1))) & ((uint64_t) bit_mask - 1))



Computes the difference between two clock counts with a mask, preventing overflow.

VENDOR_COUNTER_BASE_ADDRESS 0x40006000

Base address for vendor counter access.

VENDOR_COUNTER_READ(Vendor_offset)     ((uint32_t)*((volatile uint32_t*)(VENDOR_COUNTER_BASE_ADDRESS + (Vendor_offset))))

Reads the value from a vendor-specific counter at Vendor_offset.

VENDOR_COUNTER_WRITE(Vendor_offset, Value)     ((*((volatile uint32_t*)(VENDOR_COUNTER_BASE_ADDRESS + (Vendor_offset)))) = (Value))

Writes the given Value to a vendor-specific counter at Vendor_offset.

CPU_CNT_BIT_NUM BIT64( 32 )

Constant representing a CPU counter bit number shifted by 32 bits.

PF_RTC_BIT_NUM BIT64( 32 )

Constant representing a PF RTC bit number shifted by 32 bits.

PLATFORM_ASSERT(x) if( ( x ) == 0 ) { vAssertHandler( __FUNCTION__, __LINE__ ); }

Asserts x, calls vAssertHandler if x is 0.

BUILD_BUG_ON_ZERO(e)

(sizeof(struct { int _; int:-!!(e); }) \

- sizeof(struct { int _; }))



Triggers a build error if the expression e evaluates to non-zero.

SAME_TYPE(a, b) __builtin_types_compatible_p(typeof( a ), typeof( b ))

Checks if the types of a and b are the same.

MUST_BE_ARRAY(a) BUILD_BUG_ON_ZERO(SAME_TYPE(( a ), &(*a)))

Ensures a is an array type, results in compile-time error if not.

ARRAY_SIZE(a) ((sizeof( a ) / sizeof(*a)) + MUST_BE_ARRAY( a ))

Computes the number of elements in array a.

hex2char(val) ("0123456789abcdef"[(val) & 0xf])

Converts a nibble value to its corresponding hexadecimal character.

count_1bits(x) (uint8_t)__builtin_popcount( x )

Counts the number of 1-bits in the integer x.

count_0bits(x) (32 - count_1bits( x ))

Counts the number of 0-bits in the integer x (assuming 32-bit integer).

check_inverse(data, inverse_data, mask) ((data ^ inverse_data) == mask)

Checks if the inverse data is correct against the given mask.

SET_BIT(val, mask) ((val) |=  (mask))

Sets the bits in val specified by mask.

CLR_BIT(val, mask) ((val)  &= ~(mask))

Clears the bits in val specified by mask.

US_TO_CPU_CLK(us, residual) cal_quotient_remainder( 1000000, get_SystemCpuClock(), us, &residual )

Converts microseconds to CPU clock ticks, calculates residual in operation.

CPU_CLK_TO_US(cpu_clk) cal_quotient_remainder( get_SystemCpuClock(), 1000000, cpu_clk, NULL )

Converts CPU clock ticks to microseconds.
